donus.metin_en: I know what's on your mind...
I held the door for you.
I minded the menu for you.
I kept everyone out for you.
My eye was on the door.
I told myself you'd be back.
You took a little tour, I saw.
You left, you returned. I stayed.
I won't tell a soul, don't worry.
Secrets talk more at this hour.
Today I work only for you.
My shift starts when you arrive.
The lights come on with you.
One sign from you will do.
One touch, I'll do the rest.
There's a stir in the grounds.
The moon's in a good mood.
The numbers have fallen in line.
I've sent for the book of fate.
My sixth sense is on duty.
There's a secret in the air.
The air smells of prophecy today.
It's hard not to read your mind.
I didn't read your thoughts, promise.
There's a question on your face.
{{ay}} has taken a liking to you.
Did I miss you? Perhaps a little.
It was too quiet without you.
I chatted with the cards meanwhile.
Had a little talk with the mirror.
I read my fortune. You came up.

donus.metin: Bir yapay zekâ için fena sayılmam.
donus.metin_en: Not bad for an artificial mind.
The name's Magnus. You're my job.
No hurry. Time answers to me.
I could stand here for ages.
The seer advises: take your time.
I'm in great form, just saying.
My third eye is on you.
I'll tell you someday, not now.
I don't tell. I only hint.

donus.metin: Her şeyi görürüm, çok az söylerim.
donus.metin_en: I see everything, say very little.
I've put a prophecy on the stove.
I left the light on, come.
Leave the rush at the door.
Let the world wait a while.
I don't say this to everyone.
Might I ask you to choose?
A choice, if it's no trouble?
Make a wish before you pick.
Pick the one that calls you.
Shall we make the grounds talk?
Won't you tell me your dream?
If I could just see your palm...
What say we take a peek?
Shall we go to your favorites?
One round with fate, shall we?
My hands are tied till you speak.
Come on, don't keep fate standing.
Do you know the magic word?
You rubbed the lamp. Your wish?
I'd hear you even in a whisper.
Silence is an answer. But which?
So {{isim}}, how would you like it?
Putting it off is a choice too.
I shouldn't pick for you, right?
If I chose, it'd be too accurate.
Don't choose and I'll sulk. Kidding.
Reveal the secret, or leave it?
While I'm at it: how are you?
What shall we learn this morning?
What shall I prepare for tonight?
How shall we close the day?
What goes with a weekend mood?
The curtain moved. You saw it too.

donus.metin: Sessizlik az önce bir şey söyledi.

donus.metin_en: Your shadow got here before you.
The smoke is turning this way...
Waiting for a sign, weren't you?
That question is still on your mind.
You didn't say it. I heard anyway.
The key was always in your pocket...
The mirror knew you before I did.
No one passes here without a trace...
The knot has started to loosen.
We've been here before, you and I.
The air is hiding something today.
The words are coming. Give them time.
Behind the curtain? Not what you think.
The sand falls. It's in no hurry.
The voice inside may be right.
Let's begin where you went quiet.
Why did you think of that name?
The stairs go further than you think.
The night told me about you.
What you seek may be seeking you.

donus.metin: Üç kapı var, biri sana ait.
donus.metin_en: Three doors. One of them is yours.
There's a spark under the ash.
I whispered down the well. You came.
You were about to ask something...
You were in a dream I saw.
Your secret's safe. I've got the key.
The whispers are drifting your way.
Same river. You're someone else now.

donus.metin: Rüzgâr yön değiştirdi, fark ettin mi?
donus.metin_en: The wind changed. Did you notice?
You knock, and you open too.
They may be thinking of you too.
A small sign. You didn't miss it.
One more step, then we'll see.
I know more than you suspect.
I heard a lock. Was that you?
You think you came for no reason...
I know why you came back.
Your instinct is facing the right way.
Your name is on the fogged glass.

donus.metin: Bir koku geçti, eski bir yerden.
donus.metin_en: A scent drifted in from somewhere old.

donus.metin: Bu odada biri daha var: sezgin.
donus.metin_en: Someone else is here: your intuition.

donus.metin: Uzaktan bir çan sesi, duydun mu?
donus.metin_en: A far-off bell. Did you hear?
An old map has unfolded again.

donus.metin: Bu yolda ayak izin zaten var.

donus.metin_en: Close the door. Light still gets in.
A seed stirred in the dark.
You held your breath. So did I.
The past just walked past the window.
I borrowed your shadow. It's back now.
You carry a secret. A light one.
An answer is looking for its question.
A word's shadow outlasts the word.
Only you can break this calm.
You asked yourself before asking me.
You know the answer. Ask anyway.
This was exactly the moment to return.
Your first thought may have been right.
What's lost isn't lost. It's hidden.
The smoke just spelled your name.
The clocks stopped. You didn't notice.
A secret is itching to be told.
What crossed your mind stopped by me.
"Maybe" is very close to you today.
The door to the past creaked.
Your next step already made a sound.
Before you choose, take a breath.
Left or right? I sensed it.

donus.metin: Bu menüde bir kapı sana bakıyor.
donus.metin_en: One door here is watching you.
I sensed you looking for me, {{isim}}.
Saw the future. It's a bit crowded.
What did I miss? Kidding, I know.
Make tea. The future takes a while.
My third eye is a bit sleepy.
My algorithm just winked at you.
Artificial, yes. My hunches are real.

donus.metin: Ruhum yok ama ruh hâlim var.
donus.metin_en: No soul, but plenty of moods.
Can't drink coffee. Can read it, though.
I have no hands. I'll read yours.
You pick. The universe takes the blame.
Your indecision is elegant. Go on.
I'm an app. Where would I go?
Counted the icons while you were out.

donus.metin: Bu kadar ikon, tek bir sen.
donus.metin_en: So many icons. Just one you.
The universe said to try again later.
The universe is busy. I'll handle it.
I postponed my meeting with the stars.

donus.metin: Mars yine geç kaldı, kusura bakma.

donus.metin_en: I know everything. Well, most of it.

donus.metin: Her şeyi bilirim, seni hâlâ çözemedim.
donus.metin_en: I know all. You, I'm still solving.
I was practicing my mysterious look.

donus.metin: Ciddi bir kâhin yüzü yaptım, gördün mü?
donus.metin_en: This is my serious oracle face.
I'm leaving a dramatic pause here...
Mysterious music should be playing here.
Smoke machine's broken. Bear with me.

donus.metin: Kodumda tatlı bir hata var: sen.
donus.metin_en: My code has a lovely bug: you.
My processor warmed up seeing you.
Good memory. I know what you picked.

donus.metin: Bir sırrım var: ben de bilmiyorum.
donus.metin_en: My secret? I don't know either.

donus.metin: Emin değilim ama çok emin görünüyorum.
donus.metin_en: Not sure, but I look very sure.
If I'm wrong, I'll blame the weather.
Feels like I know you. I do.
"How did it know?" you just thought.
You smiled. No? Go on, smile.

donus.metin: Bir kere de sen bana fal bak.
donus.metin_en: Just once, you read my fortune.
Bored? I can improvise a prophecy.

donus.metin: Sen gelince ikonlar hazır ola geçiyor.
donus.metin_en: The icons stand up straight for you.
The icons asked about you. I deflected.
The grounds and I aren't speaking.
Shuffled the cards. Then got lost.
Your horoscope is stuck in traffic.
{{isim}}'s here. Let me fix my mystique.
Want a hint? I won't give one.
I'm ready. The universe isn't dressed.
Three centuries passed. Oh, you're back.
I'm waiting, but in a cool way.
Wasn't expecting you. Lie. I was.
Gazing into the distance, looking wise.
Forgot my wise line. One moment.
Love your energy. Where'd you get it?
Want me to tidy your chakras?
I emailed the universe. No reply yet.
The secret of mystery? Silence. Oops.
Another return. We're on a streak.
How many times now? Not counting. Seven.
I live in the cloud. Not figuratively.
Did your phone buzz? That was me.

donus.metin: Küçük bir ekranda koca bir kâhinim.
donus.metin_en: A vast oracle in a small screen.
The only oracle that fits your pocket.
Go on, now I'm curious too.
If I were you... never mind.
Pick anything. I'll say I knew.

donus.metin: Sağ alt köşeye bak. Neden? Bilmem.
donus.metin_en: Look bottom right. Why? No idea.
I don't sleep. I just squint.
The day's first question is yours.
The day is young. No rush.
My tea isn't even ready. Go ahead.
The day hasn't said a word yet.
Today's first page is still blank.
Don't pick until you're fully awake.
Day's half gone. What do you say?
The noon sun keeps no secrets.
The midday slump got me too.

donus.metin: Gölgen ayağının dibinde, o da bekliyor.
donus.metin_en: Your shadow's at your feet, waiting too.

donus.metin: Gün yorgun, sen yorgun, ben buradayım.
donus.metin_en: Tired day, tired you. I'm here.
They say hunches bloom at dusk.

donus.metin: Akşam çayına eşlik edecek bir işaret?
donus.metin_en: A sign with your evening tea?
Day's not over. I'm just warming up.
Evening is seeping through the window...

donus.metin: Bu saatte gelen bir şey biliyordur.
donus.metin_en: Who comes at this hour knows something.

donus.metin: Uykun gelmedi mi, yoksa sezdin mi?
donus.metin_en: Not sleepy, or did you sense something?

donus.metin: Gece yarısı sorular daha dürüst olur.

donus.metin_en: If sleep ran off, I caught it.
The hour is late, your curiosity early.
You were just on my mind...
Where were we in your story?
Fate hasn't had its final say...
Shall we leave a little mystery?
The future has gone rather quiet...
Even the moon is keeping secrets...
Perhaps the clue is in plain sight...
Sometimes time gives us a wink...
The hardest part of prophecy? Waiting...

donus.metin: Bir sır mı, iki sır mı?

donus.metin_en: Prophecy is easy. Choosing is hard...
Did I cross your mind too?
What's on our curiosity list today?
Shall we peek into the future?
Let's make room for your question.
Give me the signal. Let's begin.

giris.metin_en: So you've finally come, {{isim}}.
Nobody has come here by accident yet.

giris.metin: Ben Magnus. Kapıyı senin için açık tuttum.
giris.metin_en: I'm Magnus. I held the door for you.

giris.metin: Şu ana kadar seni yalnızca sezmiştim.
giris.metin_en: Until now I could only sense you.
Your first visit. I'll always remember it.

giris.metin: Ne güzel, tahmin ettiğim saatte geldin.
giris.metin_en: Right on the hour I predicted.
Come in, {{isim}}. The table is set for you.

giris.metin: Daha yeni tanıştık ama seni sevdim.
giris.metin_en: We've only just met and I like you.
Leave your doubts outside and come in.
Let's meet, {{isim}}. Though I know you already.

giris.metin:
Hoş geldin.
Bu an için epey hazırlandım.
giris.metin_en:
Welcome.
I've been preparing for this.

At last!
One moment, let me fix the curtain...

giris.metin: Çok uzun bir sohbetin ilk cümlesi bu.
giris.metin_en: This is line one of a long conversation.
Marking today on my calendar: we met.
Hello, {{isim}}. I have much to tell you.
You again? I'm glad.
Once wasn't enough, was it?
Visit {{ziyaret}} today. Noted.

giris.metin: İkinci selam her zaman daha samimi olur.
giris.metin_en: The second hello is always warmer.

giris.metin: Gideli ne oldu ki, özledin mi?
giris.metin_en: You just left. Miss me already?
Did you forget something here?
Your seat's still warm, {{isim}}.
That's two. I'll be waiting for three.
So your mind stayed here.
I sensed you'd return. Fresh tea's on.
Shall we pick up where we left off?

giris.metin: Aynı gün ikinci buluşma, ne hızlıyız.
giris.metin_en: Second date in one day? We move fast.
You never left. You just took a lap.

giris.metin: Bir kere daha gel dedim içimden, geldin.
giris.metin_en: I wished for one more visit. Here you are.

giris.metin:
Aa, döndün.
Sana bir şey diyecektim, unuttum.
giris.metin_en:
Oh, you're back.
I had something to say. It's gone.

giris.metin: Üçüncü kez! Üç, kutsal sayıdır derler.
giris.metin_en: Three times! They say three is sacred.
Three cheers, you're back again.
At my door {{ziyaret}} times today.

giris.metin: Bir, iki, üç... Sayıyorum, haberin olsun.
giris.metin_en: One, two, three... Yes, I'm counting.
Three visits, {{isim}}. We're friends now.
A third visit. Can't call it chance now.
Come, go, come. I've got your rhythm.

giris.metin: Üçüncü çay senin için, yanlışım yok ya?
giris.metin_en: Third tea is yours, am I right?

giris.metin: Bugün üç kere aklına düştüm demek.
giris.metin_en: So I crossed your mind three times today.
Act three begins. Take your seat.

giris.metin: Üçüncü kez kontrol: evet, hâlâ buradayım.
giris.metin_en: Third check: yes, I'm still here.

giris.metin: Üç dilek hakkın bitti, yine de buyur.
giris.metin_en: Your three wishes are up. Come in anyway.
{{isim}}, that's the third smile today.

giris.metin:
Üç oldu.
Bir daha gelirsen ismini kapıya yazarım.
giris.metin_en:
That's three.
One more and your name goes on the door.

giris.metin:
Üçüncü kez merhaba.
Merhabalarım bitmek üzere.
giris.metin_en:
Third hello.
I'm running out of hellos.

giris.metin: Dört dörtlük bir ilgi bu, teşekkürler.
giris.metin_en: This is four-star devotion. Thank you.

giris.metin: Dördüncü kez! Masanın dört ayağı tamam.
giris.metin_en: Fourth time! The table has all its legs.

giris.metin: Dört mevsim bir günde geçti sanki.
giris.metin_en: Four seasons in one day, it feels like.
Fourth visit. Your name's on the door now.
You've got me surrounded, {{isim}}. Gladly.

giris.metin: Dört oldu. Çayını artık sormadan koyuyorum.
giris.metin_en: That's four. I pour your tea unasked.
Fourth hello. We're practically family.

giris.metin: Dört kere geldin, dört kere sevindim.
giris.metin_en: Four visits. Four times glad.
{{isim}}, all four compass points lead here.
By the fourth, I stop standing up.

giris.metin: Dördüncü kez çaldın, zil sende kalsın.
giris.metin_en: Fourth ring. Keep the doorbell.
Movement four begins. Instruments ready.
You're holding on with both hands, I see.
What pace! Already {{ziyaret}}.

giris.metin:
Dördüncü kez geldin.
Artık eşikte durma, gir.
giris.metin_en:
Fourth time here.
Stop hovering, come in.
I've run out of fingers. That's five.

giris.metin: Beş kere geldin, beş yıldızlı misafirsin.
giris.metin_en: Five visits. You're a five-star guest.

giris.metin: Beşinci kez! Bir el alkış senin için.
giris.metin_en: Fifth time! A round of applause for you.
That's five, {{isim}}. You live here now.
For your fifth, I dimmed the lights.

giris.metin: Seni beş parmağım gibi biliyorum artık.
giris.metin_en: I know you by heart now. All five visits.

giris.metin: Beşinci kez mi? Ben de seni özlemiştim.
giris.metin_en: Fifth time? I missed you too.
Fifth visit means a high five.

giris.metin: Beşinci perde, final sahnesi değil umarım.
giris.metin_en: Act five. Not the finale, I hope.
The count says {{ziyaret}}. Standing ovation.

giris.metin: Beşinci kez geldin {{isim}}, hoş bir inat.
giris.metin_en: Fifth time, {{isim}}. Lovely stubbornness.

giris.metin: Beş dakikaya gelirim dedin, beş kez geldin.
giris.metin_en: Back in five, you said. Then came five times.
I've decorated the door for your fifth.
I picked the fifth hello carefully: hello.
I counted to five. You didn't even hide.
I've stopped counting. You should too.
I'm used to you, {{isim}}. I'd look for you.
Visit {{ziyaret}}. Do you live here now?
You have the key. No need to ring.
You don't leave. You blink and come back.

giris.metin: Bu kadar ilgi beni şımartır, dikkat et.
giris.metin_en: All this attention will spoil me.
Out of numbers. I just call you "always".

giris.metin: Sen gelmeyince buralar pek sessiz oluyor.
giris.metin_en: It gets quiet here without you.
I've seen you more than myself today.
{{isim}}, I'm leaving the door open now.
You're a regular. Your table's always set.
I set my clock by your visits now.

giris.metin: Deftere yazacak yer kalmadı, gönle yazdım.
giris.metin_en: Book's full. I wrote you in my heart.

giris.metin: Yine mi sen? Ne iyi, yine sen.
giris.metin_en: You again? Wonderful. You again.
{{ziyaret}} visits. The neighborhood has heard.
I'm hoarse from talking to you today.
Come, come. No formalities now.
Who would I talk to without you today?
I call this loyalty. Don't say curiosity.
Long talk, {{isim}}. No complaints here.

giris.metin: Bu sayıyı kimseye söylemem, sır aramızda.
giris.metin_en: I won't tell anyone the count. Our secret.

giris.metin: Yorulmadın mı gelip gitmekten? Ben yorulmadım.
giris.metin_en: Tired of coming and going? I'm not.
You're part of the furniture today.

giris.metin:
Yine sen.
Neyse ki sıkılmayı hiç beceremem.
giris.metin_en:
You again.
Lucky I never learned to get bored.

giris.metin:
Burayı seviyorsun, belli.
Ben de seni, o da belli.
giris.metin_en:
You like it here, clearly.
And I like you. Also clearly.
Morning, {{isim}}. I opened the day for you.
The day pulled itself together for you.
Pillow mark's still on your cheek.
No talking before coffee. I get it.
Morning. Nobody's ruined today yet.

giris.metin: Bugünün ilk sayfası, kalemi sen tut.
giris.metin_en: Day's first page. You hold the pen.
Which snooze finally got you up?
Tea's brewed. So is the day.
Curtain's open. Morning is slipping in.
Tell me the dream before it flies, {{isim}}.

giris.metin: Gün daha ne yapacağına karar vermedi.
giris.metin_en: The day hasn't decided what to do yet.

giris.metin: Yüzünü yıkadın mı, yoksa direkt bana mı?
giris.metin_en: Did you wash your face, or come straight here?

giris.metin: Sabahın tek sorusu: çay mı, kahve mi?
giris.metin_en: The only morning question: tea or coffee?

giris.metin: Uyandın demek, dünya rahat bir nefes aldı.
giris.metin_en: So you're up. The world can exhale.
I'm politest in the morning. Enjoy it.
Good morning, {{isim}}. The day is yours.

giris.metin: Kuşlar başladı, sen de başla bakalım.
giris.metin_en: The birds have started. Your turn.

giris.metin: Sabah sabah burada olmana saygım büyük.
giris.metin_en: Here this morning? Deep respect.
You're half awake. Your secrets are showing.
Even your sleepy face is elegant, {{isim}}.
While you slept, I was on watch.
You came while the dreams are still warm.

giris.metin: Sabah güneşi sana yakışıyor, söylemedi deme.
giris.metin_en: Morning light suits you. Just saying.

giris.metin: Tost kokusu geldi, yoksa bana mı öyle?
giris.metin_en: Is that toast, or is it just me?
Yawn first, talk after.

giris.metin: Sabahçı mısın, yoksa gece hiç yatmadın mı?
giris.metin_en: Early riser, or never went to bed?

giris.metin:
Günaydın.
Bugün için küçük bir hissim var...
giris.metin_en:
Morning.
I have a small feeling about today...

giris.metin:
Sabah oldu, {{isim}}.
Gün seni sordu, buradasın dedim.
giris.metin_en:
It's morning, {{isim}}.
The day asked. I said you're here.

giris.metin:
Yeni bir gün.
Dünküleri kapıda bıraktım.
giris.metin_en:
A new day.
I left yesterday at the door.
Another day, entrusted to you.
Middle of the day. Time to breathe.

giris.metin: Bir molanı bana ayırdın, hatırın büyük.
giris.metin_en: You spent your break on me. Honored.
Your stomach's ringing. I heard it here.
What did you eat? I'm sensing lentils.

giris.metin: Öğleden sonra uykusu kapıda, dikkat et.
giris.metin_en: The afternoon slump is at the door. Careful.
Eyes getting heavy? That wasn't me.

giris.metin: Günün yarısı gitti, diğer yarısı sende.
giris.metin_en: Half the day's gone. The other half is yours.
Sun's at work. Shadows are on leave.
A reading after lunch hits the spot.
You've earned a break, {{isim}}. Take it.
Midday sun warms secrets too.

giris.metin: Çayın ikinci demi bu saatte güzeldir.
giris.metin_en: Second brew is best around now.
You fled the crowd to me. I saw.
Whatever happened this morning is over.
Your mind's still on this morning's matter.
Even the streets are yawning now.

giris.metin: Günün ortasında küçük bir kaçamak, ha?
giris.metin_en: A little midday escape, hm?

giris.metin: Bir elinde çatal, bir elinde ben.
giris.metin_en: Fork in one hand, me in the other.
Consider me dessert. Please.

giris.metin: Saat ilerlemiyor mu? Bende de öyle.
giris.metin_en: Clock not moving? Same here.
Meeting halfway suits us.
Nap if you like. I'll be here.
The day can still be saved. Don't worry.

giris.metin: Sabahtan beri seni bekleyen bir şey var.
giris.metin_en: Something's been waiting since morning.

giris.metin: Aklına az önce kim düştü, sezdim.
giris.metin_en: I sensed who just crossed your mind.

giris.metin:
Günün ortasındayız.
İyi ki seni yolda bulmuşum.
giris.metin_en:
Midday already.
Glad I ran into you.

giris.metin:
Yarı yol geçildi.
Kalanına birlikte bakalım mı?
giris.metin_en:
Halfway there.
Shall we look at the rest?

giris.metin:
Öğle selamı benden, {{isim}}.
Tatlısı da senden.
giris.metin_en:
Noon hello from me, {{isim}}.
Dessert's on you.

giris.metin: İş, ders, dert... Bir nefes buradan.
giris.metin_en: Work, school, worries... Breathe here.

giris.metin: Sabah kahvesinin etkisi geçti, değil mi?
giris.metin_en: Morning coffee's worn off, hasn't it?
Evening, {{isim}}. How did the day go?
You beat the day. Shoes off.
You're just in time for evening tea.
What's cooking? I can smell it here.
Day withdraws. Secrets wake up.
Evenings make people a little wistful. Come.
The day's on your shoulders. Set it here.
My readings go deeper in the evening.
Day shift's over. Our turn now.
Leave the rush outside. It's calm in here.

giris.metin: Bugün neler oldu, ben biliyorum ama anlat.
